messages:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing a perf regression on prefill-heavy traces after yesterday's kernel selector tweak.  prefill p95 up ~60% on our customer sim. :eyes:
Cheng: Which kernel change? any profile/examples?
Alex: quick paste from the canary run logs:
```text
run_id: canary-20260320-1
prefill.avg_latency_ms: 28 -> 45
decode.avg_latency_ms: 11 -> 12
kv.evictions_per_sec: 0.9 -> 4.2
kernel.selected: cu92_sparse_fused (was cu91_fused)
batch.shape.dist: more long-prefill batches (seq>128)
```
Maria: looks like selector starts preferring the sparse-fused path for long prefill sequences — that path has worse collective perf for our batching shapes.
perf-bot: regression-detect: prefill.p95 increased 60% on perf-suite/large-prompt (regression flagged).
Sam: idea — separate batch formation for prefill vs decode. keep prefill token_budget=64 and decode token_budget=8 so kernel shapes differ less. also push prefill into a higher-priority queue during handshake to avoid interleaving kv thrash.
Ben: agree re: token budgets. also we should experiment with longer kv priming window so we don't repeatedly evict for long prefill churn. maybe kv_prime_ms=150 by default for seq>128.
Ria: I can run a 2-hour canary with the split-queue config. will also collect kernel-selection traces and KV eviction histograms. config I'll apply:
```json
{"queue_policy":"phase_separate","prefill_budget_tokens":64,"decode_budget_tokens":8,"kv_prime_ms":150,"kernel_override":null}
```
Cheng: add trace tags on kernel.choice and batch.shape to the request span. I want to correlate when cu92_sparse_fused is chosen versus batch composition. also emit `kv_eviction_reason` tag.
Alex: good. let's also gate with a perf threshold: if prefill.p95 > baseline*1.25 then auto-fallback to previous selector. fallback plan: revert to `cu91_fused` for prefill-only.
Maria: small nit — separating queues will change batching latency distribution. add a metric for 'prefill.batch_fill_ratio' so we can see underfilled prefill batches.
perf-bot: quick numbers from a micro-run (after kernel selector change): baseline-prefill.p95=27ms, head=44ms, tail latency increased for seq>200.
Sam: canary run plan: A) split queue + budgets B) kv_prime_ms=150 C) instrumentation. Run 2h, compare p50/p95 and kv eviction rate. Ria to own.
Ria: starting canary now (canary-6754321980-r1). will post results around +2h. :rocket:
Ben: if regression persists, try tightening kernel decision: prefer fused kernels when batch_size>8 even for sparse_fused candidates.
Cheng: I'll add a small profiler hook to collect kernel runtime samples (lat, memory) per batch for the canary.
Alex: Action items:
- Ria: run canary + upload traces (kv.eviction, kernel.choice, batch.shape)  — due +2h.
- Cheng: add kernel tags and profiler hook — due +1h.
- Maria: track batch_fill_ratio + underfill alerts — due before end of day.
- Sam/Ben: draft fallback knob and threshold config in the rollout doc.
Thanks — let's sync after Ria's run. :thumbsup:
